author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಗೌರವವ ಕೊಟ್ಟುಪಡೆ ಗುಣಗಳಿಸಿ ಹಂಚುತಿರು
ಮಾರದಿರು ಹಿರಿಯರಿಟ್ಟಾತ್ಮದಭಿಮಾನ
ತೋರುತಿರೆ ನಿರ್ಲಕ್ಷ್ಯ ಘನತೆವೆತ್ತಾರ್ಯರೆಡೆ
ಜಾರುವೆಯೊ ಕಂದಕಕೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Give respect and receive it; earn virtues and keep sharing them;
do not sell the self-respect your elders gave you;
if you show neglect toward the noble and dignified,
you will slide into a ditch, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Respect is earned by giving it. Share your virtues, guard the self-respect handed down by your elders, and never disregard the noble, or you will fall.
